item.title: I made an agent skill for making HTML slides with consultant style
item.description:
I was a consultant in one of the top firms and have been an software engineer before joining consultancy... As an engineer, I really don't like to deal with the software made by Windows, especially the Office -- yep, I hate doing PPT..

so I made MBB Page Maker - The project generates static HTML/CSS/JS decks. It can export HTML, PDF, and PNG. I made it as an agent skill so it can work with Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, or any agent that can read local files.

Repo: https://github.com/NomiciAI/mbb-page-maker

Examples: https://nomici.ai/mbb-page-maker/examples/ai-erp-saas-lop/index.html https://nomici.ai/mbb-page-maker/examples/agent-technology-outlook/index.html

I'd like your feedback on this. Pls try!
